diagnosis: The server configuration endpoint applies incoming DTO updates to the persistence entity using a MapStruct mapper that does not ignore the ownerAccountId field. An attacker can supply their own account ID in the JSON body while updating an arbitrary server, causing MapStruct to overwrite the entity owner and hijacking full root ownership of competitor cloud virtual machines.
